deals.description: ♥️ I managed to cover some major tourist attractions in Vienna through a SINGLE booking. No separate queues, no euro stress or exchange rate headache. SO CONVENIENT! 👑 This covered the Schönbrunn Palace, Belvedere, the Danube cruise, Giant Ferris Wheel & the Big Bus Hop-on Hop-off. Plus so many wonderful attractions on the big bus tours are free like the Schönbrunn Gardens, Belvedere Gardens, Hofburg Palace complex & Heldenplatz, St. Stephen’s Cathedral (Stephansplatz), Parliament, City Hall (pre book), exterior of the Opera House. ✅ I found it to be a safe city, pretty accessible, mostly people understand English, and plenty of halal options everywhere. Comment “VIENNA” and I’ll DM you the full itinerary including an airport pro tip. Next reel: Vienna’s food scene #vienna #viennatravel #viennathingstodo #europetravel #austria
